actions.label: Search the desk
actions.description: Find documents on the desk by their exact words.
actions.agent: Use when you cannot tell which file holds something, or what changed in a time window. Exact-word search across the desk. Filters: track, status, kind, since, until. `scope`: 'active' (default), 'archived' or 'all'. With no `query`, or `newest: true`, it lists documents by when they were updated, newest first, inside the since/until window (`scope` then defaults to 'all').

query.label: Query
query.description: The search query. Omit it to list documents by update time.

newest.label: Newest first
newest.description: Pass true to order by update time, newest first, instead of by match.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Filters, as a JSON object (not a string).

since.label: Since
since.description: Only documents updated at or after this time (ISO 8601).

until.label: Until
until.description: Only documents updated at or before this time (ISO 8601).

actions.label: Recall
actions.description: Recall what the desk says about a topic.
actions.agent: Use for loose recall, as in `do I remember anything about X`. Ranks every desk Markdown file by meaning and exact words together. `scope`: 'active', 'archived' or 'all' (default; this is the historical lookback).

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

actions.label: Read a skill
actions.description: Read one of Desk's skills, or list them.
actions.agent: Use when your client cannot load Desk's skills itself (claude.ai, ChatGPT): read one of Desk's skills, the working procedures its instructions point to. With no `name`, lists every skill with its description; with `name`, returns that skill's text to follow. Read-only and needs no desk.

name.label: Skill
name.description: The skill to read, such as task-lifecycle; omit it to list every skill.
